en: Sepia-toned military postcard showing a long line of cavalry soldiers on horseback drawn up in formation on an open field. The troopers wear pickelhaube-style spiked helmets and carry lances with pennants. Several officers are in front of the ranks. Printed German text appears along the top, with additional red handwritten German annotations across the upper part of the card.
